title: Fast N' Loud
description: Richard pays big bucks hoping to use a '63 Cadillac for a quick flip project; the guys do a bang-up job on a budget, but Jason goes rogue and risks tanking the whole thing.

title: Fast N' Loud
description: Richard Rawlings and his crew of Monkeys race to finish a replica 1937 Buick Indy Racer for a deep-pocket client; the 1975 Datsun 280 Z draws a buyer, sending Richard racing to the bank.

title: Fast N' Loud
description: Richard races toward a vintage payday by restoring his '37 Buick Racer back to its Indy 500 roots; the guys buy a one-owner '77 Blazer that could fetch them double their money; a surprise birthday gift has Richard feeling nostalgic.

title: Fast N' Loud
description: The Monkeys put the pedal to the metal in their final attempt to finish the 1972 Buick Riviera super-build in time for SEMA; the team's integrity is on the line, and $300,000 has been invested, so failure is not an option.

title: Garage Squad
description: The Garage Squad needs some divine intervention to get this pastor's hulk of a '74 Bronco out of garage hell.

title: Garage Squad
description: This Nova has been in the family for three generations and seen more that its share of rough patches; now the grandson is on a mission with the Garage Squad to bring it back to glory for Grandma.

title: Garage Squad
description: After years sitting in storage in a corn crib a 1956 Ford Truck gets some TLC; does the old girl have enough life left, to get her back out on the road?

title: My Classic Car
description: My Classic Car captures America's love affair with the automobile! Dennis Gage, the handlebar mustachioed host, takes you along for the ride and keeps it entertaining with his unique perspective and enthusiasm for all things automotive.

title: Roadkill Garage
description: David and Steve encounter further issues with the Bang-Shifting Cougar.

title: Roadkill Garage
description: Freiburger and Dulcich get the F-Rod 1931 Model A fired up and ready for racing.

title: Roadkill Garage
description: Freiburger and Dulcich beat on David's '99 Dodge Ram and Steve's '73 Chevy.

title: Roadkill Garage
description: The legendary '68 Dodge Charger General Mayhem gets stripped of its 707-hp Hellcat engine and all the related electronics; Freiburger and Dulcich vow to take it from the drag strip setup back to its motorhome 440-powered V8 and gravel-chucking roots.

title: Roadkill Garage
description: The COVID-350-powered, six-speed 1956 Chevy Bel Air may sport 500 hp, but is far from perfection; Freiburger and Dulcich bring it closer to reaching their goals with some weight reduction, suspension modifications and a new 9-inch rear end.

title: Roadkill Garage
description: Steve Dulcich enlists the help of crew member and fellow '80s action-movie enthusiast Wiley Stevens to get the '67 Bang Shifting Cougar back on the road; the guys install a new trans, suspension and custom hood, among other upgrades.

title: Build for Off-Road
description: This year's Adventure Ride kicks off out west on the Rimrocker Trail, taking the team from Montrose, Colo. to Moab, Utah; along the way, the crew finds places to camp, while putting their rigs and overlanding skills to the test.

title: Build for Off-Road
description: We finish the Rimrocker Trail and roll into Moab, Utah; but the adventure is just getting started as we tackle the obstacles of Behind the Rocks, then cap it all off with one of the most breathtaking trails in the country, Top of the World.

title: Truck U
description: The 1951 Willys pickup that Matt Steele got from Willie B last year is in the shop for the first time. We will build a new firewall, tear down the engine for some new upgrades, and build out the Dana 44 axles that will end up under the truck.

title: Roadkill Garage
description: After years of paint and body work, it's finally time to piece the Crop Duster back to life, so the guys get the engine and transmission back in the freshly painted beauty after adding some extra cubic inches.

title: Build for Off-Road
description: After coming down from the top of the World, the team takes on one of Moab's trails, Hell's Revenge; with drop-offs, steep climbs and the infamous Hell's Gate, this trail puts both the rigs and drivers to the ultimate test.

title: Roadkill Garage
description: David and Steve nab a '56 Chevy 210 that was once an NHRA champion, but the body is complete garbage; they try to bring the car closer to its former glory, then it's off for some passes at the Kingman Street Drags on Route 66.

title: Shorty's Dream Shop
description: Shorty's buddy Tommy has a '69 Camaro that needs some love, with damaged paint on the hood and malfunctioning headlight motors; another friend, T-bone, stops by with his '65 Impala for an air ride, updated interior and repainted steering wheel.

title: Shorty's Dream Shop
description: Shorty's friend Porkchop wants to turn a '69 Firebird convertible into a tribute Trans Am for his wife; Shorty and his team transform the car with a new spoiler, motor mods with AC and fuel injection, custom interior and custom racing stripes.

title: Shorty's Dream Shop
description: Arturo is a good friend of the shop, and his classic Nova will be a monster, with a rebuilt supercharged 6.2 LS, plus upgrades to the chassis and brakes; the crew revives a classic 1924 LaFrance fire truck for the nearby Cedar Hill Fire Department.

title: Shorty's Dream Shop
description: An Amber Glow 1955 DeSoto might be pink, but it has a hemi under the hood; 2000 Chevy dually is a monster, but needs a new paint job, interior and air ride system.

title: Shorty's Dream Shop
description: Shorty tries to match the Ember Glow hemi's original color, then works his magic in the paint booth; Joel tries to figure out how to install an aftermarket AC; PG works on the interior; the crew is left with an enormous amount of trim.

title: Shorty's Dream Shop
description: A big fan of the movie "Training Day" wants his '78 Monte Carlo to be built in the same vein; the G-body needs the works, including a swapped LS, beefed-up brakes and suspension and a new interior; Shorty's G10 parts runner van needs a facelift.

title: Shorty's Dream Shop
description: Shorty's right-hand man in the body shop, Joe Gomez, has been in remission from cancer for nearly 10 years and wants to create a wide body Honda Accord for his wife to show his appreciation.

title: Shorty's Dream Shop
description: After losing a grandson in a racetrack crash, Rick Wilson and his family want to raise money to promote safety at tracks around Texas; they enlist Shorty and the team to build a 1956 Corvette that will be auctioned off for their cause.

title: Shorty's Dream Shop
description: The '56 Corvette is complete, but not without a couple of twists; the family decides to change the body color from red to arctic blue with a silver teardrop; Shorty brings in the best in the business for a lowrider paint seminar at the shop.

title: Garage Squad
description: Having fallen in love with this beat-up old '78 Chevy K20 as a teenager, this farm girl knew she had to have it; after a tough year, the Garage Squad is called on to help her and her truck start a new chapter in life.

title: Garage Squad
description: A very rare '70 'Cuda convertible has been sitting for over 10 years, slowly dying; the Garage Squad takes this amazing opportunity to help its cancer-surviving owner get this Mopar monster back on the road.

title: Garage Squad
description: A battered 1993 GMC Typhoon is saved from some crooked mechanics and its turbocharged bite is restored.

title: Motorhead Garage
description: If it goes, Dave Dobson and the Motorhead Garage crew are fans. They bring you their love for all things motorized as they modify cars, trucks, ATVs and motorcycles using aftermarket equipment, ranging from the tried-and-true to the innovative and new.

title: Shorty's Dream Shop
description: Shorty's is traditionally a Chevy shop, but this week, a Ford collector who's always dreamed of a Shorty paint job convinces them to take on his '71 Torino GT; but what looks like a pretty straight car is hiding a can of worms underneath.

title: Two Guys Garage
description: Willie B and Kevin Byrd help bring a young enthusiast's dream to life. They prep a 1977 Pontiac Trans Am for Madi's very first driving test, joined by her crew of fellow young gearheads pushing the build across the finish line.

title: Hot Rod Garage
description: Tony Angelo, Lucky Costa and guest Lindsay Ross transform a banged-up 1987 Chevrolet G10 work van into a 1977 Boogie Van clone.

title: Two Guys Garage
description: A family-run animal rescue organization needs a maintenance overhaul on the two vehicles they use to rescue their animals.

title: Hot Rod Garage
description: Lucky Costa's personal '66 Chevelle gets major upgrades to its 6.0L LS truck engine.

title: Hot Rod Garage
description: Tony Angelo and Lucky Costa take their '65 LeMans project and turn it into a road-trip hauler and put it to the test on a trip of their own.

title: Hot Rod Garage
description: Tony Angelo and Lucky Costa dive into the red-hot C10 truck market and show how to build a killer short bed truck on a long bed budget.

title: Roadkill Garage
description: The General Mayhem 1968 Dodge Charger is back together and better than ever, with its 440 big-block power plant and rust-free sheet metal.

title: Roadkill Garage
description: Freiburger and Dulcich finish the 1970 Plymouth that has languished away on the farm for so long; they transformed it from junk into one of the nicest piles in the Roadkill fleet, and undoubtedly one of the best at brutal burnouts for distance.

title: Ride of Your Life With Courtney Hansen
description: In an emotional moment, Courtney and her team at ROYL Garage surprise 9/11 first responder Tory Diblasi with the IROC of his dreams.

title: Ride of Your Life With Courtney Hansen
description: After 40 years of repairing Lincolns for others, master mechanic TC receives a surprise; Courtney and her team reveal a custom 1965 Continental convertible during a celebration in New Orleans.

title: Ride of Your Life With Courtney Hansen
description: Jeremy had to sell his 1969 Camaro to pay for college and now dedicates his life to running marathons for charity, writing music and building guitars as hobbies, so Courtney lures him to Nashville's Music Row for a surprise reveal of a badass Camaro.

title: Ride of Your Life With Courtney Hansen
description: Bill Adams sells his one-of-one 1969 Road Runner convertible in Petty blue to pay medical expenses for his autistic son who has been battling leukemia.

title: Ride of Your Life With Courtney Hansen
description: When she was younger, Terry had to sell her Mustang when she got pregnant.
